main_text.p: consecratum[?], quodque iterum lubentis-simè; quantulumcunque est, offero, æ-qui boniqe, ut sæpius amanter fecit, consulere dignetur. Deus Opt. Max. te Ecclesiæ suæ quam diutissime conser-vet incolumem.
main_text.head: EPIST. LXVI.
Dubia quædam de rebus Ecclesiasticis.
main_text.p: Perquam Reverendo Domino Johanni Morino, Congregationis Oratorii Presbytero, Viro celeberrimo, deque Ecclesia Dei longe optime merito S.P.D. Bartholdus Nihusius.

FElicissimus ego mortaliūsum[?]. Quamobrem verò ? quia non tam scribere ad me, quàm effundere viscera animi erga nos benevoli, tibi placuit: quo quidem beneficio longe indignissimus homuncio Nihusius. Viderit perquàm Illustris meus D. Turrius, beneficiis istius pro me procurator. Ita enim affectus

page.notes: Doubtful readings: "consecratum" (first letters faint, read as confecratum in print), "mortaliūsum" (tilde and letters unclear). The italic/roman division in the superscription is partly unclear; "Johanni Morino" and "Bartholdus Nihusius" read as roman there. The subject line is treated as a level 2 title. The running head is printed in small capitals and is reproduced in capitals.
